referencePolicy.style: simple matte low-poly forms feasible with ordinary Three.js primitives, indexed mesh geometry, opaque standard materials and declared common lights/effects
referencePolicy.generation: new image_gen reference for each round; original returned PNG retained with provenance

reviewRequirement: Coordinator reviews primitive/material feasibility and absence of engine advice or previous results in the image and shared brief before author dispatch.

notes: Simple house planes and rectangular trims, low-poly conical trees and faceted bushes, block walls and paving, angular car body and cylinder wheels can be authored with ordinary Three.js primitives and indexed meshes.
Matte palette and common warm sun/ambient fill; no photo textures, elaborate foliage, reflections or optional post effects are required.
Both authors receive this same image before results; no prior authored scene is supplied.

provenanceLimits: The retained generation receipt is a coordinator attestation to the image_gen operation, not independently authenticated generator provenance.
